package.name: pinkrab_safety
package.description:
The gate every command crosses on its way to the servos. It takes /joint_commands, holds each pose against the joint bands and against the same MuJoCo scene the studio draws, walks it in from where the arms actually are at max_joint_speed_dps, and republishes what survives on /joint_commands_checked.
Its own node rather than part of the driver, so the thing holding the serial bus never learns what a teleop mode is. It also owns what an operator is allowed to believe - armed, mode, and why the last command did not go through - and publishes that as TeleopState, because a page keeping its own copy of those is a page that can lie about a moving arm.
